definitions.name: G0D.SUM
definitions.body: 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Sum of a Vector of numbers (0 for an empty Vector).

definitions.name: G0D.MEAN
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V G0D.SUM V LENGTH DIV
definitions.note: Arithmetic mean of a non-empty Vector of numbers.

definitions.name: G0D.MOD
definitions.body: 'B' BIND 'A' BIND A A B DIV FLOOR B MUL SUB
definitions.note: a b G0D.MOD leaves a - b*floor(a/b), the remainder.

definitions.name: G0D.ABS
definitions.body: 'X' BIND X -1 MUL X X 0 LT SELECT
definitions.note: Absolute value of a scalar, or lane by lane over a Vector.

definitions.name: G0D.ARGMAX
definitions.body: -1 MUL ORDER 0 GET
definitions.note: Index of the largest number in a Vector; the first one on ties.

definitions.name: G0D.MAXV
definitions.body: SORT -1 GET
definitions.note: Largest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

definitions.name: G0D.MINV
definitions.body: SORT 0 GET
definitions.note: Smallest element of a Vector of numbers or Strings.

definitions.name: G0D.TOP-KEY
definitions.body: 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES G0D.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: Key of a Record whose numeric value is largest; the first key on ties.

definitions.name: G0D.PAIRS
definitions.body: 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP
definitions.note: A Record as a Vector of [ key value ] pairs in key order.

definitions.name: G0D.SUMS-BY
definitions.body: GROUP 'G' BIND G KEYS G VALUES [ 0 [ ADD ] FOLD ] MAP RECORD
definitions.note: keys values G0D.SUMS-BY leaves a Record from each key to the sum of its values, keys in first-appearance order.

definitions.name: G0D.LEDGER-SUMS
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L [ 0 GET ] MAP L [ 1 GET ] MAP G0D.SUMS-BY
definitions.note: Vector of [ name amount ] entries to a Record name -> summed amount.

definitions.name: G0D.WORDS
definitions.body: ' ' TOKENIZE [ '' EQ NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: Split a String on spaces into its non-empty words (any spacing, leading/trailing spaces allowed).

definitions.name: G0D.JOIN-WITH
definitions.body: 'S' BIND [ 'W' BIND S W 2 COLLECT ] MAP FLATTEN 'F' BIND F 0 1 F LENGTH 0 EQ SELECT DROP JOIN
definitions.note: vector sep G0D.JOIN-WITH joins a Vector of Strings with the separator between them ('' for an empty Vector).

definitions.name: G0D.CAP
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W CHARS 1 TAKE JOIN UPPER W CHARS 1 DROP JOIN LOWER 2 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: A word with its first letter upper-cased and the rest lower-cased.

definitions.name: G0D.DIVISORS
definitions.body: 'K' BIND 1 K RANGE [ 'D' BIND K K D DIV FLOOR D MUL SUB 0 EQ ] FILTER
definitions.note: Ascending Vector of the positive divisors of a positive integer.

definitions.name: G0D.IS-PRIME
definitions.body: G0D.DIVISORS LENGTH 2 EQ
definitions.note: Whether a positive integer is prime.

definitions.name: G0D.PRIMES
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 N RANGE [ G0D.IS-PRIME ] FILTER
definitions.note: Ascending Vector of the primes <= a positive integer (empty for 1).

definitions.name: G0D.BINARY
definitions.body: 'N' BIND [ 32 16 8 4 2 1 ] [ 'P' BIND N P DIV FLOOR 2 G0D.MOD ] MAP STR JOIN 'S' BIND S CHARS S '1' SEARCH DROP JOIN
definitions.note: An integer 1..63 written in base 2 as a String without leading zeros.

definitions.name: G0D.COLLATZ-STEP
definitions.body: 'I' BIND [ 'X' 'C' ] BIND X X 2 DIV X 3 MUL 1 ADD X 2 G0D.MOD 0 EQ SELECT X 1 EQ SELECT C C 1 ADD X 1 EQ SELECT 2 COLLECT
definitions.note: FOLD step over [ value steps ]: applies one Collatz move unless value is already 1; the second operand (the fold element) is ignored.

definitions.name: G0D.COLLATZ
definitions.body: 'N' BIND 1 130 RANGE N 0 2 COLLECT [ G0D.COLLATZ-STEP ] FOLD 1 GET
definitions.note: Number of Collatz steps to reach 1 for an integer 1..60 (130 bounded iterations).

definitions.name: G0D.FIB-INDEX
definitions.note: Smallest k with F(k) >= n (F(1)=F(2)=1), for n up to 987.

definitions.name: G0D.ORDERS
definitions.body: JSON-DECODE 'orders' GET
definitions.note: The orders array of a JSON order document, as a Vector of Records.

definitions.name: G0D.REVENUE
definitions.body: G0D.ORDERS [ 'price' HAS? ] FILTER [ 'O' BIND O 'qty' GET O 'price' GET MUL ] MAP 0 [ ADD ] FOLD
definitions.note: Sum of qty*price over the priced orders of a JSON order document.

definitions.name: G0D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: Median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle values when even).

definitions.name: G0D.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND 0 V LENGTH 3 SUB RANGE [ 'I' BIND V I DROP 3 TAKE 0 [ ADD ] FOLD 3 DIV ] MAP
definitions.note: Means of every three consecutive numbers of a Vector of at least three.

definitions.name: G0D.VARIANCE
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V G0D.MEAN SUB 'D' BIND D D MUL G0D.MEAN
definitions.note: Population variance of a Vector of numbers.
